AUTHOR: Rimmer
TITLE: Underwater Computer Vision for Ecologists: A Framework for Curating Image Training Datasets for Object Detection
REGION: Barkley Sound and Clayoquot Sound, Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada (two seaweed farms + reference sites)
SPECIES: Fish pseudo-taxa (Actinopterygii, Embiotocidae, Phanerodon vacca, Cymatogaster aggregata, Sebastes sp., Aulorhynchus flavidus, Salmonidae, forage fish, Clupea pallasii) plus gelatinous zooplankton groups and drift algae
DATA: Own unbaited RUV 'FishCam' footage (12 cameras, Mar 2022-Jun 2023, 9037 h); training annotations from Mar-Nov 2022 (~241,000 annotations, 54 pseudo-taxa)
V_EV: Sec. 2.2.2: videos with animals 'were often obscured by high turbidity, fast movement, light attenuation'; Sec. 2.1: 'cameras were deployed at 6 m depth'.
D2: 90/10 train/test images (no validation set); test set 8376 images
D_EV: Sec. 2.2.9: 'we reserved 10% of all images, with representatives from all categories, to test our output model.'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1.2 / Table 4: performance reported only on the 10% held-out test images from the Mar-Nov 2022 annotated FishCam dataset.
C_EV: Sec. 3.1.2: 'calculated using an optimal confidence threshold of 0.25 ... The threshold was selected based on the F1 score'
E_EV: Table 4 reports only 'Precision, recall, mean average precision ... and F1' per pseudo-taxon; MaxN outputs referred to Bates et al. [19].
ARCH: YOLOv8 (final detector); YOLOv5 and ResNet-18 screening, salient motion filter and Online-InReaCh anomaly filter used for annotation curation
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95, F1, confusion matrix; annotation-effort retraining curves
NOTE: Seaweed (kelp) farm + reference-site moored RUVs with wild fauna; not fish aquaculture -> INCL=Y, ENV coded 온대 암반/켈프 (kelp farm; '양식' arguable). Multi-taxon model (fish + gelatinous zooplankton + algae) with fish results reported. Test split: 10% of images stratified by category from 1-fps frames incl. adjacency-filter frames; no grouping or leakage discussion -> D_ALL=N. YOLOv8 applied to Dec 2022-Jun 2023 footage (new season) but no performance reported -> R1=N. MaxN computed for the parent project but not reported/evaluated here -> E1=없음. PRE from Discussion statement 'feature transfer during transfer learning from the ImageNet task'. NIMG not clearly stated (241,000 annotations; ~84k images implied by 8376 = 10%).
AUTHORS_FULL: Rimmer, T; Bates, C; McIntosh, D; Zhang, T; Albu, AB; Juanes, F
